title: The Devops Engineer Who Never Sleeps — Diamond Bishop, Datadog
talk_summary: Diamond Bishop describes Datadog's vertical task-specific agents (AI on-call engineer, AI software engineer) that orient from runbooks, form and test hypotheses with tools, and suggest remediations. The transferable lessons are about scoping narrow jobs-to-be-done, eval-first development, and LLM observability for debugging multi-step agent runs.

takeaways.technique: Eval-first, living test set per vertical agent
takeaways.what_they_do: They scope each agent to a narrow job-to-be-done and build offline, online, and living evals with end-to-end task measurements before/while building, treating evals as the hardest part.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the number of mistakes we made by not thinking about eval first is uh frustrating

takeaways.technique: Hypothesis-test loop with tools before concluding
takeaways.what_they_do: The on-call agent forms hypotheses about root cause, then uses tools (logs, metrics, traces) to validate or invalidate each one before suggesting remediation.
takeaways.evidence_quote: put together hypothesis on what might be happening and reason over them coming up with ways to test them

takeaways.what_they_do: They deliberately build narrow, task-specific agents rather than one generalized agent, so each job is measurable and verifiable step by step.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we build out vertical task specific agents rather than building out generalized agents

takeaways.what_they_do: They render multi-step agent runs as a graph with error nodes highlighted, because raw call lists of hundreds of steps are unreadable for debugging.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you're not going to look at this and figure out what's going on right away

takeaways.what_they_do: They keep the agent layer general so any new off-the-shelf model can be swapped in, rather than fine-tuning to a specific model/task.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you should be at a point where you can easily try out any of these models

takeaways.what_they_do: After remediation the agent writes a postmortem covering what happened, what it did, and what humans did, ready for the morning.
takeaways.evidence_quote: our agent can do the same write out your postmortem for you
